claims.scope_condition_supplied: Supplied to the EXTRACTED Delphi record (not a correction of Turing 1952, who treats finite rings): a growing linear mode needs det(J-qD) = Du Dv q^2 - S q + det J < 0 at at least one ACTUAL admissible q of the stated domain. The record's inequality S > 2 sqrt(Du Dv det J) (with S>0) is q-independent: it only says the continuum band is non-empty, which is necessary but NOT sufficient on a finite domain. Example J=[[1,-2],[2,-3]], Du=1, Dv=10, Neumann: band q in (1/5,1/2) is non-empty, length pi has no admissible q in it, length 2 pi has exactly mode 1 (q=1/4, trace -19/4, det -1/8). Onset length: strictly unstable modes exist only for L > sqrt(2) pi (an infimum, not attained: at exactly sqrt(2) pi mode 1 sits on the band edge, det=0, marginal). Linear instability only; no nonlinear pattern is proved or observed.

kavita_7_point.1_headline: Two chemicals that spread at different speeds can make an evenly mixed tissue break into spots or stripes, but only if the tissue has room for a pattern of the right size.
2_sources: Turing (1952) The chemical basis of morphogenesis, doi:10.1098/rstb.1952.0012 (as cited in the published nanopub's provenance)
kavita_7_point.3_species_in_claim: none: the claim is chemistry-generic. (Its proposedTest names no organism.)
kavita_7_point.4_datasets_needed: biochemical kinetics (reaction Jacobian) and diffusivities of a candidate morphogen pair, measured independently; then perturbation/imaging data of pattern change. Which specific datasets: NOT determined here (dataset discovery not run)
kavita_7_point.5_species_inventory_mapping: n/a for this claim (no species); see turing-wavelength for organisms named in its proposed test
kavita_7_point.6_species_with_complete_multiscale_recor: NOT determined. Not asserted for any organism.
kavita_7_point.7_math_representation: u_t=f+Du lap u, v_t=g+Dv lap v linearized at a homogeneous state with tr J<0, det J>0. Continuum band non-empty iff S=Dv f_u+Du g_v>0 and S^2>4 Du Dv det J (the record's condition). A mode with admissible wavenumber^2 q grows iff det(J-qD)<0, i.e. q lies strictly inside the band. Lean covers the finite-mode integer algebra and tail bound for a declared model (Routh-Hurwitz is a Lean definition).

claims.bucket: empirical and not formalizable (as a whole)
claims.reason: The record's notation says 'no canonical formalization' and types it a principle-or-framework: an empirical hypothesis not settled by any model theorem. That does not make it untestable: operational sub-tests for a declared system can be formalized (the turing-ddi finite-domain check is one) and the record's own proposedTest is a measurable protocol. Excluded from theorem evaluation rather than forced into Lean. Mechanical buckling, prepatterns and cell-cell signalling can produce the same patterns, so a matching pattern does not identify the mechanism.
